item.title: Multiple areas of graffiti have been spray-painted directly onto the road surface (big half marathon "support") around the roundabout and along the adjoining roads. The graffiti interferes with the existing road markings making them difficult for road users to identify clearly. This presents a safety hazard, particularly for drivers approaching and navigating the roundabout. Additionally, it is not in keeping with the aesthetic character of the surrounding area and has a negative visual impact on the locality. Greater monitoring, control and enforcement is required during event set-up and throughout events to prevent unauthorised graffiti by and markings on the highway. Planning ahead, and timely, on-the-spot intervention would help prevent associated grafitti, interference with road markings, reduce safety risks, minimise damage and maintain the appearance of the area. The affected areas require inspection and appropriate remedial action., 7th September
